items.question: A child tells you something worrying. What do you do first?
Which is an example of positive discipline?
options: Explaining the rule and praising good behaviour

items.question: Who should you report a safeguarding concern to?
options: The child protection focal person or sector officer

items.question: Which can be a sign that a child needs help?
options: Being hungry at lunch time only once

items.question: What should happen to the information you hear?
options: Keep it confidential and pass it only to those who must act
Write it on the notice board
